name: Kruger House, Pretoria
scope: The standing 1884 single-storey Kruger residence including its southern covered stoep, stairs and paired stone lions.
era: The surviving house museum exterior with its original late-nineteenth-century street elevation.

originalReview.notes: The original photograph offered at accession P00295.412 identifies the long street-facing stoep, spaced posts, decorative iron brackets, central door and low balustrade. Trees interrupt the full roof view.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the published Qualla gallery. Its only public-domain candidate has uncertain photographic authorship, and the modern exterior carries attribution terms. The exact Australian War Memorial rendition is explicitly marked public domain on its dated native accession.
